title: abies balsamea var. nana
intro: Abies balsamea var. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Balsam Fir, is a dwarf variety of the Abies balsamea tree, native to the northeastern United States and southeastern Canada. The essential oil extracted from the needles of this plant has been used to promote relaxation and reduce stress, thanks to its calming and soothing properties. The health benefits of Dwarf Balsam Fir include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which can aid in the relief of respiratory issues and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and medicinal properties.
